headline: Evergrande Liquidators Sell Property Services Stake for $513 Million
summary: Liquidators of China Evergrande Group agreed to sell a 51% stake in its property management arm to investment firm PAG for HK$4.03 billion ($513.6 million).
why: China Evergrande Group's debt default is a central event in China's ongoing property sector crisis, and asset sales are monitored by creditors seeking recovery.

impacts.name: China Evergrande Group
impacts.why: Asset divestments generate liquidity required to service outstanding creditor liabilities.
